title: ittcsecscan least-privilege permission template
description: The read-only permissions ittcsecscan requires for one provider under one profile, and, for each permission, which collectors or rules it enables (ADR-0016 §3). Permission lists are populated by the collectors that declare them, so a template is legitimately empty until then. A template is trusted only after live access-denied verification; until then its verification status is "unverified".

profile.description: The least-privilege profile (ADR-0005): discovery and deep-evidence are read-only; remediation is separate and never the default.

verification.description: The verification status of the template as a whole. Verified only when every permission has passed live access-denied verification against a real, disposable test account (ADR-0016 §3).

permissions.description: The permissions this profile grants. Empty until collectors declare their needs.

date.description: When the live verification was run.

method.description: How it was verified, for example the maintainer-run live harness test name.

then.description: A verified entry must carry evidence: nothing is trusted on the word 'verified' alone.

permission.description: The provider-native permission identifier: an AWS IAM action, an Azure RBAC action, or a GCP permission.

enabled_by.description: The collectors or rules that require this permission. A permission with no justification is not least-privilege, so at least one is required.
